turns.assistant_text:
Here’s a brief summary of the latest news about OpenAI:

### Tin mới nhất về OpenAI

- **fable 5.2 feels like a noisy opus 5.5 with higher highs but lower lows**  
  Needs more testing, but for most things I just can't justify the extra usage over opus 5.5. This leaves the door wide open for OpenAI and 6.2 Astra IMO. I couldn't care less if this was the renamed fable 5.5 or whatever, it doesn't matter, this is what they released.  
  [Read more](https://x.com/zwb44/status/2120137261119414389)

- **GPT 更新之后，数据管理那里悄摸摸的多了个位置共享**  
  在设置Settings > 数据管理 Data Control. 大家记得检查下网页版和 codex 是不是都关了，这俩不同端按钮的状态还是分开的。防止 OpenAI 的限流机制和降智真的与地理位置有关。  
  [Read more](https://x.com/feishutoday/status/2120137252626190800)

- **@grok なんでいつまでたっても金型職人の技コピーできひんの？**  
  調理AIロボとかもゴミ・オブ・ゴミやろ。米国でOpenAIとかが出資してる調理ロボの製品みたけどお笑いやったで。なにが技術的障壁なんや人間とロボットで。最近日本でもIndeedとかで製造向けAIの営業求人とかあるけどゴミやろ.  
  [Read more](https://x.com/aaa223344/status/2120137242887016834)

Now, would you like me to send this summary to your Telegram? Please confirm.
